containers.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)] gap-4
containers.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-white/10 h-screen sticky top-0 bg-[#080808]
containers.card: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 p-4 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-white/10 transition-colors duration-300

terminal.style: font-mono text-xs text-green-400 bg-black p-4 rounded-sm border border-white/10 h-full overflow-y-auto scrollbar-hide
terminal.cursor: inline-block w-2 h-4 bg-green-400 animate-pulse ml-1

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/50 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)] transition-all uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold py-2 px-4 clip-path-polygon-[0_0,100%_0,100%_70%,90%_100%,0_100%]
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-slate-300 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold py-2 px-4
buttons.destructive: bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/50 hover:bg-red-500/20 transition-all uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold py-2 px-4

inputs.default: bg-black border border-white/10 text-white placeholder-slate-600 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500/50 transition-all font-mono text-sm py-2 px-3 rounded-none

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) against dark backgrounds. Use lighter slate colors (slate-300/200) instead of dark grey.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (cyan-500).

universal_guidelines: Use data-testid attributes for all interactive elements.
Do not use generic gradients; use solid dark colors or subtle noise textures.
Charts must use Recharts with the defined neon color palette.
Layouts must be responsive; use grid-cols-1 on mobile.
Use 'Rajdhani' font for all section headers to maintain the sci-fi aesthetic.
Implement 'Augmented UI' style (cut corners) using clip-path for key buttons/panels.
Show 'System Status' indicators (blinking lights) in the header.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install required dependencies: lucide-react, recharts, framer-motion, clsx, tailwind-merge.
instructions_to_main_agent.structure: Create a 'components/ui' folder for reusable atoms. Create a 'layouts' folder for the main dashboard shell.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Add the font imports to index.css. Extend tailwind.config.js with the custom colors and fonts defined above.
